QuestInfo.name: Red Eyes Below
QuestInfo.0: #b#p502##k in #m10004000# has news from the deep Ant Tunnel.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p502##k says #r#o51#s#k now crowd the tunnel past #m10005080#, on the old path toward the place where the Balrog sleeps. I need to defeat #r100 #o51#s#k and bring him #b40 #t4000045#s#k.
QuestInfo.2: I defeated the #r#o51#s#k past #m10005080# and brought #b#p502##k their eyes. He will keep them by his fire. If they start to glow, he will know the Balrog is waking.

0.0:
Since you cleared the place where Tristan fell, I've been listening to the travelers who come up from the tunnel. But before I send you down there, I need to know you were listening too. Tell me: who saved my life in the Ant Tunnel?
#L0##bTristan#k#l
#L1##b#p501##k#l
#L2##b#p603##k#l
0.1: Good. You remember. The travelers all say the same thing: #r#o51#s#k are gathering past #m10005080#, on the old path toward the place where the Balrog sleeps. Defeat #r100 #o51#s#k, and bring me #b40 #t4000045#s#k. I want to see them for myself.
#b#p501##k? He builds houses. He's never been deeper than #m10005000#. Come back when you remember.
0.2: #b#p603##k? He knows herbs, not the Balrog. Come back when you remember.

yes.0: The path starts past #m10005080#, at the end of #m10005077#. The #r#o51#s#k hit hard. Don't hold back.

no.0: Hmph. I can't blame you. That path isn't for the careless.

1.0: You made it back. Good. And you brought their eyes.
1.1: ...They were glowing red down there, you say? I saw that once before. On the day Tristan fell.
1.2: Even after they're taken, they glow when the Balrog stirs. Tristan taught me that. I'll keep these by my fire and watch them every night.
1.3: Take this. We're not finished, you and I.
